taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-11 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 82.6 | 5.04 | 5.04
2 | 162.4 | 1.62 | 6.66
3 | 121.3 | 2.57 | 9.23
4 | 152.0 | 0.91 | 10.14
5 | 105.9 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

**Station:** T-11
**Curve type:** KHK
**Aquifer depth:** 10.14 m and below
**Recommendation:** The marked resistivity drop below 10.14 m (152.0 → 105.9 ohm-m) suggests transition into a more conductive, potentially water-bearing formation; drilling should target this zone, with continuous sampling from 10 m depth onward to confirm aquifer material and saturation.
